_meta.description: Tier-4 multi-currency envelope: FxRate register, GLLine multi-currency overlay (MODIFIED REQ-GL-003: amount → transactionAmount + baseCurrencyAmount/baseCurrency/fxRate/fxRateSource/fxRateDate), and the two ScheduledWorkflow records that drive ECB ingestion + period-end FX revaluation. Sibling change bookkeeping-multi-currency already shipped BankAccount.primaryCurrency + CurrencyBalance (T3 surface); this fragment adds the T4 envelope surface those build notes (Tasks 5-10) deferred. Declarative per ADR-031 — no FxRateImportJob extends TimedJob and no FxRevaluationService PHP class.

FxRate.title: FX Rate
FxRate.description: Daily exchange-rate snapshot per (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, date, source) tuple per REQ-MC-002. The FX orientation contract is `baseCurrencyAmount = transactionAmount × fxRate` — i.e. `rate` is the price of 1 unit of transactionCurrency in baseCurrency. ECB publishes rates with baseCurrency=EUR per their canonical orientation; the ECB ingestion ScheduledWorkflow MUST invert exactly once on ingest so the stored `rate` always matches the FX orientation contract above. Manual operator overrides MUST carry a `manualOverrideReason`.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: FxRate snapshots are immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — they drive GL postings and consolidation translation. Manual overrides MUST be auditable (who, when, why).

x-openregister-uniqueness.description: Per REQ-MC-002 a single rate per (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, date, source) — duplicate ingest MUST be a no-op, not an overwrite.

transactionCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code for the currency the GL line was transacted in. Example: USD.
transactionCurrency.title: Transaction Currency

baseCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code for the administration's functional currency. Example: EUR.
baseCurrency.title: Base Currency

date.description: Effective date of the rate (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD). Matched on or before the GL line's transaction date.
date.title: Date

source.description: Provenance of the rate. `ecb` rates are ingested by the daily ScheduledWorkflow; `manual` rates require `manualOverrideReason`; `bank-feed` rates come from the BankConnector adapter.
source.title: Source

rate.description: Exchange rate expressed as transactionCurrency → baseCurrency. baseCurrencyAmount = transactionAmount × rate. ECB published rates MUST be inverted on ingest if their canonical orientation differs.
rate.title: Rate

inverseRate.description: Optional convenience: 1/rate. Computed on ingest, NOT used by the GL posting engine (which always reads `rate`). Surfaces in the FX Rates index for operator readability.
inverseRate.title: Inverse Rate

manualOverrideReason.description: REQUIRED when source=manual per REQ-MC-002 precondition. Operator-supplied justification (e.g. 'ECB feed unavailable for 2026-03-08; using bank-quoted rate').
manualOverrideReason.title: Manual Override Reason

ingestedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the rate landed in the register (set by the ingest workflow or operator UI).
ingestedAt.title: Ingested At

administrationId.description: Optional administration scoping. Most deployments share a single ECB ingest across all administrations (administrationId=null = global).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

supersede.description: Operator marks a manual rate as superseded after the canonical ECB rate becomes available; preserves the audit trail without deletion.

transactionAmount.description: Amount in transactionCurrency, integer cents (positive). Per MODIFIED REQ-GL-003 the on-the-wire property name remains `amount` on legacy records; this declaration carries the new semantic name as an additive alias. The OR schema engine accepts both; existing single-currency callers keep working without rename.
transactionAmount.title: Transaction Amount

transactionCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code for the currency the line was transacted in. Renamed from `currency` per the RENAMED Requirements block in add-shillinq-multi-currency/specs/bookkeeping-multi-currency/spec.md. NULL on legacy single-currency lines (treated as administration's baseCurrency on read).
transactionCurrency.title: Transaction Currency

baseCurrencyAmount.description: Amount in administration's functional (base) currency, integer cents. Equals `transactionAmount × fxRate` per the FX orientation contract. NULL when single-currency (transactionCurrency == baseCurrency); on read the system substitutes `transactionAmount`.
baseCurrencyAmount.title: Base Currency Amount

baseCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code for the administration's functional currency at the time the line was posted. Snapshot ensures historical re-running of reports stays correct even if the administration's base currency changes.
baseCurrency.title: Base Currency

fxRate.description: Snapshot of the FxRate.rate used at posting time. Joins to the FxRate register via (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, fxRateDate, fxRateSource). For single-currency lines fxRate=1.
fxRate.title: Fx Rate

fxRateSource.description: Provenance of the rate used at posting (matches FxRate.source). Audit-trail field — operators can trace any GL line back to the rate snapshot used.
fxRateSource.title: Fx Rate Source

fxRateDate.description: Effective date of the rate snapshot used at posting (matches FxRate.date). Usually equals the GL line's transaction date but MAY lag by 1 business day when the ECB feed has not yet published the same-day rate.
fxRateDate.title: Fx Rate Date

shillinq-fx-ecb-daily-ingest.description: Daily ECB FX-rate ingestion per REQ-MC-003. Reads the openconnector source `ecb-eurofxref-daily` (canonical orientation: 1 EUR = N FOREIGN), inverts each rate exactly once so the stored FxRate.rate matches the FX orientation contract (`baseCurrencyAmount = transactionAmount × rate`), and upserts the FxRate registry by composite key (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency=EUR, date, source=ecb). Idempotent — re-runs on the same calendar day are no-ops thanks to the composite-key uniqueness clause on FxRate.

shillinq-fx-period-end-revaluation.description: Period-end FX revaluation per REQ-MC-004. Triggered at soft-close (PeriodStatus transitioning open → soft-closed), walks every open foreign-currency position (AR/AP receivable/payable still outstanding at period end, plus bank-account balances in non-base currency), revalues at the period-end FxRate.rate, and posts one balanced GLTransaction per administration carrying the unrealised gain/loss. Realised gain/loss on settlement is declared as an x-openregister-lifecycle action on the T2 Invoice / Receipt sub-ledger schemas (separate fragment).

ias21-translation-functional-to-presenta.description: IAS 21 / RJ 122 functional-to-presentation currency translation per REQ-MC-005. Applied during consolidation when a subsidiary administratie's functional currency differs from the group's presentation currency. Balance-sheet items translate at closing rate (FxRate.rate at consolidation date), P&L items at average rate (mean of daily FxRate.rate over the period), equity at historical rate (FxRate.rate at original posting date). Cumulative translation adjustment (CTA) posts to a dedicated equity-OCI bucket per IFRS rule. Declarative Mapping — no ConsolidationTranslationService PHP class.

rules.description: Balance-sheet items use the period-end (closing) rate per IAS 21.39.
P&L items use the period's average rate per IAS 21.39.
Equity items retain the historical rate at the date of the originating posting per IAS 21.39.

ctaPosting.description: Cumulative translation adjustment (CTA) posts to equity-OCI bucket 3990 per IFRS rule.
